newsitem.title: USA: Mellon's chairman to retire in '98.
newsitem.headline: Mellon's chairman to retire in '98.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp Chairman Frank Cahouet said on Tuesday that he plans to retire in December 1998, as he has previously announced.

"It's my understanding with the board that I will retire in December 1998," said Cahouet, who will turn 65 next month. He was responding to a shareholder's question at Mellon's annual meeting, following the release of first-quarter earnings.
He did not elaborate on whether Mellon plans to hire an internal or external candidate to succeed him, but said, "We have a very fine senior management team in place."
